### Common repairs  
Common repairs to the Mira robot vacuum include clearing blocked suction paths, replacing worn brushes, repairing wheel assemblies and dealing with charging faults. Our support team will help identify the problem and explain whether it can be resolved at home or needs an engineer.  

[P2] Servicing and engineer visits  
## Mira robot vacuum  
### Servicing schedule  
Routine servicing helps keep your Mira robot vacuum working as intended and gives an engineer the opportunity to check for wear, damage and faults that may not be obvious during use. Servicing supports the care described in your user instructions; it does not replace cleaning, emptying the dust container or removing trapped hair and debris.  

[P3] Warranty  
### Repairs under warranty  
If your Mira robot vacuum develops a fault covered by its warranty, Halvard Home will arrange a repair and cover the necessary labour, parts and transport. We will explain what happens next and keep you informed as your repair progresses.

The Halvard kitchen design service includes servicing and engineer visits. To book a consultation with Halvard Home, contact Halvard Home customer support and explain what is wrong. Before getting in touch, write down when the problem started and whether it happens every time you use the hood. Have your address, contact number, and any purchase or warranty details ready. Tell the adviser if the hood is difficult to reach or if there are any access restrictions at your property. Ask the adviser to confirm the appointment date, any call-out charge, and what the visit includes before agreeing to the booking. On the day, clear the hob and surrounding worktop so the engineer can reach the hood safely. Leave any inspection or dismantling to the engineer.
